We're doing a constrained migration of a protected dataset next week and need a short, time-boxed CMK grant so our partner (CloudVault) can rewrap snapshots. Request details below:

- Requested window: 2025-07-24 00:00 UTC -> 2025-08-07 23:59 UTC (two weeks)
- Scope: rewrap snapshots in region us-west-2 only (dev+staging mirrored backups excluded)
- Purpose: data migration to Varia's new storage cluster; existing KEK cannot be exported

Thanks,

Team — forwarding Varia's ask (below). High level: they need a short-lived CMK grant + audited evidence for access and rotation during a two-week window. Requesting triage and owners:

- Marissa: lead on customer-facing playbook & runbook; legal handoff and acceptance criteria for MOU.
- Irene: security owner for KMS grant design, logs we can export, and proof package format.

Please respond with: 1) feasibility, 2) minimal set of deliverables we can provide to close compliance acceptance, 3) ETA for runbook and evidence export. I'll loop Legal once we have deliverables.

Mateo

Thanks — I can own the playbook. Draft plan attached (draft_playbook_v1.md) and TL;DR below: 

1) Authorization model: issue a scoped KMS Grant limited to principal arn:aws:iam::cloudvault:role/rewrap-only and resource-key only in us-west-2. Grant will be issued via an internal job that tags the grant with request_id=SEC-3421 and window metadata.
2) Audit surface: enable verbose KMS event logging for the key during the window (kms:CreateGrant, kms:RevokeGrant, kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:ReEncryptFrom, kms:ReEncryptTo). Stream to our audit stream; create an evidence export script that produces: newline-delimited JSON with timestamp, request_id, principal, action, requestId (KMS request id), and sha256 of the encrypted blob id.
3) Evidence handoff: upload ZIP to the shared Drive folder and provide checksum and signed manifest. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1a2b3c_varia-evidence
4) Safety: implement an automated revocation job at window end + alert to SRE. If revocation fails, immediately escalate to on-call + block future grants for that key.

We will need Legal confirmation on the MOU language for temporary KEK access and a sentence stating Redwood will provide the evidence package as described. Legal, if you can confirm acceptance criteria (manifest fields / retention window) we can finalize the draft.

Attachments: draft_playbook_v1.md (markdown runbook)

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Product Manager, Security Integrations

From: irene.choi@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary CMK window request & audit evidence ask

Thanks for the plan — +1 on approach, a few technical clarifications and items we must include in the runbook before we send to Legal/Customer: 

- Grant lifecycle: we'll create grant G-<short> with metadata tags: {request=SEC-3421, requester=cloudvault-sa, start=2025-07-24T00:00:00Z, end=2025-08-07T23:59:59Z}. We will programmatically call RevokeGrant at end of window (idempotent).
- KV cache invalidation: any node with cached plaintext DEK references should be signalled; implement edge hook to drop KEK-wrapping cache at grant start to force fresh wrap. Priyom: we need an infra job that posts a rolling restart to the cache service; test plan required.
- Sample log lines (what we'll export):
  2025-07-24T01:02:13.123Z kms CreateGrant requestId=abcd-1234 principal=arn:aws:iam::cloudvault:role/rewrap-only keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/xxx
  2025-07-24T01:03:05.987Z kms ReEncryptTo requestId=wxyz-5678 principal=arn:aws:iam::cloudvault:role/rewrap-only keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/xxx targetKey=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222:key/yyy

- Evidence integrity: include SHA256 manifest for each exported file and a signed envelope (Redwood fs-key) so Varia can validate authenticity.
- Retention: we can keep the audit export available for 90 days in the evidence folder; if Varia needs longer, Legal must sign the addendum.

I'll run the KMS grant playbook in a staging key tomorrow and paste results into the draft_playbook_v1.md. Priyom — please confirm the restart job ETA and whether we have any customers using the same key that would be impacted during the cache drop. Also propose a time for a short (30m) sync with Varia + Legal + CloudVault next morning (2025-07-24 17:00 UTC suggested).

Irene Choi
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
